name: MsD & MsP
source:
A short kinetic novel where a teacher and her student get it on.

*Based on Romulo Melkor Mancin's comic "[url=https://melkormancin.com/950117/breaking-in-tim]Breaking in Tim[/url]".
translation:
一部简短的动态小说，讲述了一位老师和她的学生的故事。

*改编自罗慕洛·米尔科·曼辛的漫画《[url=https://melkormancin.com/950117/breaking-in-tim]Breaking in Tim[/url]》。
